# Game Assets matching "Christmas score popup countdown game over golden red"

Use `import_source(path)` to import any asset into your scene.

- **67 Hot Digits** (OART): Chunky display digits with a white-to-orange-to-red vertical gradient, soft rounded corners, and a warm halo.
  - path: `art_text/67.oart`
  - tags: art_text, score, countdown, counter, digits, gradient, warm, orange, red, fire, energetic, hot-streak, 3d, chunky
  - license: Internal
- **Arcade Chrome** (OART): Blocky uppercase display with a yellow-to-red gradient fill plus stacked navy and chrome outlines.
  - path: `art_text/vi_arcade.oart`
  - tags: art_text, arcade, retro, 8bit, pixel, game-over, title, start-screen, level-complete, orange, chrome, vintage, classic, game
  - license: Internal
- **Clock / Timer** (PNG): Clock icon for countdown/timer display
  - path: `ui/icons/icon_clock.png`
  - tags: clock, timer, time, icon, ui, game
  - license: CC0
- **Dark Overlay** (PNG): Semi-transparent black overlay for modal/popup backgrounds
  - path: `ui/panels/overlay_dark.png`
  - tags: overlay, mask, dark, panel, ui, modal
  - license: CC0
- **Score Badge** (PNG): Gold rounded badge — for floating score popup (+100, combo, etc.)
  - path: `ui/hud/badge_score.png`
  - tags: score, badge, popup, hud, ui, game
  - license: CC0


> **Need more?** These are local pre-made assets. For higher-quality stickers, 3D characters, and accessories, use `search_library(query="...", category="sticker|character|accessory|game_module")` to search the Effect House cloud library — cloud assets look **much better** than default primitives. When results are found, **import them** with `import_from_library(asset_id=...)` inside `edit_by_dsl`.
